purpose: One read-only portfolio view across independently frozen boundary experiments. It does not merge evidence identities, alter lane mechanics or permit their overlapping PnL to be summed.

lanes.primary_arm: first H43 order per Polymarket market

portfolio_rules.independence: Each lane is scored by first eligible attempt per market and clustered by market and UTC day.
portfolio_rules.capital_overlap: Signals sharing a market window or resolver exposure are competing uses of capital, never additive trades.
portfolio_rules.promotion: Each lane must separately pass its immutable minimum sample, duration, doubled-cost, chronological-half and clustered-lower-bound rules.
portfolio_rules.selection_correction: Correct across all strategy arms and inspected boundary variants, not just the three displayed lanes.
portfolio_rules.null_outcome: All three lanes may have approximately zero edge.
